en.scope: Calculate the ratio of two user-entered dietary amounts. This tool does not assess blood pressure, cardiovascular risk, electrolyte status, or clinical need.
en.calculated: CALCULATED — direct arithmetic from the entered amounts.
en.complete_inputs: Enter a non-negative sodium amount and a positive potassium amount.
en.limits: The ratio describes only the entered amounts. It is not a dietary target, reference range, diagnosis, or treatment recommendation.
en.disclaimer: Educational measurement only. Food labels, serving sizes, laboratory results, medications, kidney function, and health conditions are not assessed by this calculation.
en.save_failed: Save failed. Sign in and try again.
